## Description

Use boosted decision trees to predict/rank returns or probabilities from technical, fundamental and/or macro features.

## Where it may fit

Tabular features with nonlinear interactions and frequent retraining/monitoring.

## Vehicles

Quant equity, ETF allocation, futures/FX signals.

## Required data

Point-in-time feature table, labels, corporate actions, release timestamps, cross-validation and costs.

## Caveats

Forecast accuracy does not imply trade profitability; optimize after costs and use leakage-safe walk-forward tests.
